name: Close 2U ~Saigo no Natsuyasumi~
source:
Twin brothers dream of becoming wind surfing professionals. Together with three other boys and six girls they go on a tropical island. This may be a summer when dreams come true.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2018/12/vn-of-month-june-2000-age-maniax-isumi.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
一对双胞胎兄弟梦想成为职业帆板运动员。他们与另外三名少年和六名少女一同前往一座热带岛屿。在这个夏天，梦想或许真的会成为现实。

[引自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2018/12/vn-of-month-june-2000-age-maniax-isumi.html]vndbreview[/url]]
